The parallel universe in which you now find yourself is one in which your parents never did meet- a universe which the Many Worlds interpretation assures us is out there (since every possible universe consistent with the laws of quantum physics is out there). And so, in this approach, we face no logical paradox, because there are various versions of a given moment, each situated in a different parallel universe; in the Many Worlds interpretations, it's as if there are infinitely many spacetime loaves, not just one.
